english.title: Address meeting to support / further activities of designated body for prohibited purpose
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17A(3) and (8) of the National Security Act 2023.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A “prohibited purpose” means a purpose that the person knows, or having regard to other matters known to them ought reasonably to know, is prejudicial to the safety or interests of the United Kingdom (section 17A(4)).
(ii) In this section “meeting” means a meeting of three or more persons, whether or not the public are admitted; and a meeting is private if the public are not admitted (section 17A(9)).
(iii) This offence applies to conduct outside the United Kingdom, but only if the person engaging in the conduct is a UK person, or acts for or on behalf of, or holds office under, the Crown, or is in Crown employment (whether or not they engage in the conduct in that capacity).(iv) Additional powers of entry, search and seizure are provided in Schedule 2 where there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that this offence has been, or is about to be, committed.
(v) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, section 37 of the National Security Act 2023.
